cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer with a PhD track in AI, focusing on trustworthy and large-scale language models. At Torus University I led a department while managing research projects that built and evaluated transformer-based summarisation systems for Turkish medical texts. My work required designing data pipelines, defining training objectives, and running extensive experiments on GPU clusters, similar to the pre-training workflows you describe.

I have published on human-centered evaluation metrics for clinical AI and on LLM-as-judge methods, demonstrating my ability to create rigorous experiments and separate signal from noise. My recent involvement in COST research networks gave me experience with multi-institution data management and privacy, which supports building robust, scalable datasets for robotics.

While I have not yet programmed directly on robot hardware, I am ready to apply my expertise in large-scale model training to the physical domain. I enjoy turning abstract AI research into systems that work in real settings, and I am keen to contribute to Enact's vision of general-purpose robotic intelligence.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
